def uleb(data, off):
    result=0; shift=0; i=off
    while True:
        b=data[i]; i+=1
        result |= (b & 0x7f) << shift
        if (b & 0x80)==0: break
        shift += 7
        if shift>35: break
    return result, i

def iter_class_methods(dex, class_data_off):
    raw=dex.raw
    p=class_data_off
    static_fields_size, p = uleb(raw, p)
    instance_fields_size, p = uleb(raw, p)
    direct_methods_size, p = uleb(raw, p)
    virtual_methods_size, p = uleb(raw, p)
    def skip_fields(n, p):
        idx=0
        for _ in range(n):
            diff, p = uleb(raw, p)
            acc, p = uleb(raw, p)
            idx += diff
        return p
    p = skip_fields(static_fields_size, p)
    p = skip_fields(instance_fields_size, p)
    def walk_methods(n, p, kind):
        idx=0
        methods=[]
        for _ in range(n):
            diff, p = uleb(raw, p)
            acc, p = uleb(raw, p)
            code_off, p = uleb(raw, p)
            idx += diff
            methods.append((kind, idx, acc, code_off))
        return methods, p
    dm, p = walk_methods(direct_methods_size, p, \"direct\")
    vm, p = walk_methods(virtual_methods_size, p, \"virtual\")
    return dm+vm

def decode_insn(dex, words, op, pc):

        return f\"{name} v{a}, #{lit}\"
    if fmt==\"11x\": return f\"{name} v{aa}\"
    if fmt==\"12x\":
        a,b=nibble_regs(aa); return f\"{name} v{a}, v{b}\"
    if fmt==\"10t\":
        rel=aa if aa<128 else aa-256
        return f\"{name} +{rel} -> {pc+rel:04x}\"
    if fmt==\"21c\":
        idx=words[1]
        if op in (0x1a,0x1b): return f'{name} v{aa}, \"{dex.string(idx)}\"'
        if op==0x1c or op==0x1f or op==0x22: return f\"{name} v{aa}, {dex.type_name(idx)}\"
        if 0x60<=op<=0x6d:
            c,n,t=dex.field(idx); return f\"{name} v{aa}, {c}->{n}:{t}\"
        return f\"{name} v{aa}, id@{idx}\"
    if fmt==\"21s\":
        lit=struct.unpack(\"<h\", struct.pack(\"<H\", words[1]))[0]
        return f\"{name} v{aa}, #{lit}\"
    if fmt==\"21t\":
        rel=struct.unpack(\"<h\", struct.pack(\"<H\", words[1]))[0]
        return f\"{name} v{aa}, +{rel} -> {pc+rel:04x}\"
    if fmt==\"22c\":

        if 0x52<=op<=0x5f:

    if fmt==\"31i\":
